fusion_time@12.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@12.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end

fusion_time@9.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@9.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

fusion_time@8.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

fusion_time@1.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@1.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

fusion_time@2.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@2.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

cursed_anime_rule_2@3.name: Anime Rule #2
cursed_anime_rule_2@3.text: Each time you destroy an opponent's monster by card effect, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its ATK. Monsters you control cannot attack directly.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_DESTROYED)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return rp==0 and eg:IsExists(function(c) return c:IsPreviousControler(1) and c:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and c:IsReason(REASON_EFFECT) end,1,nil) end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) local sum=0 for c in eg:Filter(function(c) return c:IsPreviousControler(1) and c:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and c:IsReason(REASON_EFFECT) end,nil):Iter() do sum=sum+math.floor(math.max(0,c:GetPreviousAttackOnField())/2) end if sum>0 then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000199) Duel.Damage(1,sum,REASON_EFFECT) end end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_DIRECT_ATTACK) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0) e:SetTarget(function(e,c) return c:IsFaceup() and (true) end) e:SetValue(1) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end

fusion_time@6.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@6.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

fusion_time@27.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@27.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

cursed_defense_proficiency@40.name: Defense Proficiency
cursed_defense_proficiency@40.text: Halve all damage you take (rounded down). Halve all battle damage your opponent takes (rounded down).
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PRE_BATTLE_DAMAGE)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) if Duel.GetBattleDamage(ep)>0 then if ep==0 then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000191) else Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000191) end end Duel.ChangeBattleDamage(ep,math.floor(Duel.GetBattleDamage(ep)*(ep==0 and 0.5 or 0.5))) end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_CHANGE_DAMAGE) e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_PLAYER_TARGET) e:SetTargetRange(1,0) e:SetValue(function(e,re,val,r,rp) if val<=0 or (r&REASON_BATTLE)~=0 then return val end return math.floor(val/2) end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end

 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end

s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.

demonic_pact@77.name: Demonic Pact
demonic_pact@77.text: Recover half the LP cost whenever you pay it for an Archfiend card. If Pandemonium prevents an Archfiend monster’s Standby Phase cost, recover half of the prevented amount.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local standby_costs={}
 local function queue(c,amount,is_standby_monster)
  local refund=math.floor((tonumber(amount) or 0)/2)
  if refund<=0 then return end
  if is_standby_monster and standby_costs[c] then return end
  if is_standby_monster then standby_costs[c]=true end
  Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000251) Duel.Recover(0,refund,REASON_EFFECT)
 end
 local paid=Effect.GlobalEffect()
 paid:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
 paid:SetCode(EVENT_PAY_LPCOST)
 paid:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
  local c=re and re:GetHandler()
  if ep==0 and c and c:IsSetCard(SET_ARCHFIEND) then
   local upkeep=Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 and Duel.IsPhase(PHASE_STANDBY) and c:IsMonster()
   queue(c,ev,upkeep)
  end
 end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(paid,0)
 -- Pandemonium raises this event (its ID + 1; its search uses its ID) from its cost-replacement
 -- operation because replaced upkeep payments do not emit EVENT_PAY_LPCOST.
 local prevented=Effect.GlobalEffect()
 prevented:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
 prevented:SetCode(EVENT_CUSTOM+94585853)
 prevented:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
  local c=re and re:GetHandler()
  if ep==0 and c and c:IsControler(0) and c:IsMonster() and c:IsSetCard(SET_ARCHFIEND)
   and Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 and Duel.IsPhase(PHASE_STANDBY) then queue(c,ev,true) end
 end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(prevented,0)
 local reset=Effect.GlobalEffect()
 reset:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
 reset:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_STANDBY)
 reset:SetCondition(function() return Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==0 end)
 reset:SetOperation(function() standby_costs={} end)
 Duel.RegisterEffect(reset,0)
end

fusion_time@78.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@78.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

cursed_anime_rule_2@81.name: Anime Rule #2
cursed_anime_rule_2@81.text: Each time you destroy an opponent's monster by card effect, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its ATK. Monsters you control cannot attack directly.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end

fusion_time@97.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@97.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

fusion_time@101.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@101.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)

field_amplifier@46.text: Double ATK/DEF increases applied by the effects of face-up Field Spells you control. ATK/DEF decreases are unchanged.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 for _,code in ipairs({EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK,EFFECT_UPDATE_DEFENSE}) do
  local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(code) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,LOCATION_MZONE)
  e:SetValue(function(e,c)
   local total=0
   for _,bonus in ipairs({c:GetCardEffect(code)}) do
    local source=bonus:GetHandler()
    if bonus~=e and source and source:IsControler(0) and source:IsLocation(LOCATION_FZONE) and source:IsFaceup() and source:IsType(TYPE_FIELD) and not source:IsDisabled() then
     local value=bonus:GetValue()
     if type(value)=='function' then value=value(bonus,c) end
     if type(value)=='number' and value>0 then total=total+value end
    end
   end
   return total
  end)
  Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0)
 end
end

fusion_time@49.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@49.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

cursed_anime_rule_2@98.name: Anime Rule #2
cursed_anime_rule_2@98.text: Each time you destroy an opponent's monster by card effect, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its ATK. Monsters you control cannot attack directly.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_DESTROYED)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return rp==0 and eg:IsExists(function(c) return c:IsPreviousControler(1) and c:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and c:IsReason(REASON_EFFECT) end,1,nil) end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) local sum=0 for c in eg:Filter(function(c) return c:IsPreviousControler(1) and c:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and c:IsReason(REASON_EFFECT) end,nil):Iter() do sum=sum+math.floor(math.max(0,c:GetPreviousAttackOnField())/2) end if sum>0 then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000199) Duel.Damage(1,sum,REASON_EFFECT) end end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_DIRECT_ATTACK) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0) e:SetTarget(function(e,c) return c:IsFaceup() and (true) end) e:SetValue(1) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end

s:

fusion_time@103.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@103.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

fusion_time@109.name: Fusion Time
fusion_time@109.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end

cursed_anime_rule_2@109.name: Anime Rule #2
cursed_anime_rule_2@109.text: Each time you destroy an opponent's monster by card effect, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its ATK. Monsters you control cannot attack directly.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_DESTROYED)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return rp==0 and eg:IsExists(function(c) return c:IsPreviousControler(1) and c:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and c:IsReason(REASON_EFFECT) end,1,nil) end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) local sum=0 for c in eg:Filter(function(c) return c:IsPreviousControler(1) and c:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and c:IsReason(REASON_EFFECT) end,nil):Iter() do sum=sum+math.floor(math.max(0,c:GetPreviousAttackOnField())/2) end if sum>0 then Duel.Hint(HINT_MESSAGE,0,1800000199) Duel.Damage(1,sum,REASON_EFFECT) end end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_DIRECT_ATTACK) e:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0) e:SetTarget(function(e,c) return c:IsFaceup() and (true) end) e:SetValue(1) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end

fusion_time@-1.text: Fusion Summon Fusion Monsters from your Extra Deck using materials from your field, without Polymerization.
s:
if Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak then Duel.EnableRogueAntiStreak() end
-- Persistent run effects. Registered with the core, not UI-only bonuses.
do
 local given={} local function give() for fc in Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsType,0,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,nil,TYPE_FUSION):Iter() do if not given[fc] then given[fc]=true
  local e=Effect.CreateEffect(fc) e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD) e:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
  e:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE) e:SetRange(LOCATION_EXTRA) e:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION)
  e:SetCondition(function(e,c)
   if c==nil then return true end
   local tp=c:GetControler() local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   return c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION,tp,true,false) and c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp)
  end)
  e:SetTarget(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,c)
   if chk==0 then local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil) return c:CheckFusionMaterial(mg,nil,tp) end
   local mg=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil)
   local sg=Duel.SelectFusionMaterial(tp,c,mg,nil,tp)
   if not sg or #sg==0 then return false end sg:KeepAlive() e:SetLabelObject(sg) return true
  end)
  e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
   local sg=e:GetLabelObject() if not sg then return end
   Duel.SendtoGrave(sg,REASON_MATERIAL|REASON_FUSION) sg:DeleteGroup() e:SetLabelObject(nil)
  end)
  fc:RegisterEffect(e) end end end give() do local e=Effect.GlobalEffect() e:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD|EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS) e:SetCode(EVENT_PHASE_START|PHASE_DRAW)  e:SetCondition(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) return true end) e:SetOperation(function(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp) give() end) Duel.RegisterEffect(e,0) end
end
